description: Quantitative affinity tests on the complete ARHGAP23 and ARHGAP21 holdup profiles, including all non-binding peptides
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats
pd.set_option("display.width",250)
S=pd.read_csv("profaff_ARHGAP21_23_rows.csv")
S["pKd"]=pd.to_numeric(S.COMP_neglogKd,errors="coerce")
S=S[S.pKd.notna() & S.peptide_10mer.notna()].copy()
S["pep"]=S.peptide_10mer.astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()
S=S[S.pep.str.len()>=4]
S["P0"]=S.pep.str[-1]; S["Pm1"]=S.pep.str[-2]; S["Pm2"]=S.pep.str[-3]; S["Pm3"]=S.pep.str[-4]
def cl(r):
    if r.P0 not in set("VILFAMC"): return "non-canonical P0"
    return "I" if r.Pm2 in "ST" else "II" if r.Pm2 in "VILFAMWY" else "III" if r.Pm2 in "DE" else "atypical"
S["ligand_class"]=S.apply(cl,axis=1)
S.to_csv("profaff_ARHGAP_measured_peptides.csv",index=False)

print("="*84); print("COMPLETE MEASURED AFFINITY PROFILE (ProfAff, PMID 36115835). pKd=0 means no binding detected."); print("="*84)
for g in ["ARHGAP23","ARHGAP21"]:
    d=S[S.PDZ==g]
    print(f"\n{g}: {len(d)} peptides measured; {(d.pKd>0).sum()} with detectable binding ({100*(d.pKd>0).mean():.0f}%)")
    print(f"   pKd of binders: median {d[d.pKd>0].pKd.median():.2f}, max {d.pKd.max():.2f}  (pKd 5 = 10 uM)")
    print("   top 10 by affinity:")
    print(d.nlargest(10,"pKd")[["PBM","peptide_10mer","Pm3","Pm2","P0","ligand_class","pKd"]].to_string(index=False))

print("\n"+"="*84); print("TEST 1  Does the ARHGAP23 PDZ domain bind class I peptides more tightly? (all peptides)"); print("="*84)
rows=[]
for g in ["ARHGAP23","ARHGAP21"]:
    d=S[S.PDZ==g]
    a=d[d.ligand_class=="I"].pKd; b=d[d.ligand_class.isin(["II","III","atypical"])].pKd
    u,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(a,b,alternative="greater")
    # rank-biserial effect size
    rb=2*u/(len(a)*len(b))-1
    rows.append(dict(domain=g,n_classI=len(a),n_other=len(b),
                     median_pKd_classI=round(a.median(),2),median_pKd_other=round(b.median(),2),
                     mean_pKd_classI=round(a.mean(),2),mean_pKd_other=round(b.mean(),2),
                     rank_biserial=round(rb,3),mannwhitney_p=f"{p:.3g}",
                     frac_binding_classI=f"{100*(a>0).mean():.0f}%",frac_binding_other=f"{100*(b>0).mean():.0f}%"))
T1=pd.DataFrame(rows); T1.to_csv("profaff_classI_affinity_test.csv",index=False); print(T1.to_string(index=False))

print("\n"+"="*84); print("TEST 2  Within class I peptides, does an acidic P-3 raise affinity?"); print("="*84)
rows=[]
for g in ["ARHGAP23","ARHGAP21"]:
    d=S[(S.PDZ==g)&(S.ligand_class=="I")]
    a=d[d.Pm3.isin(set("DE"))].pKd; b=d[~d.Pm3.isin(set("DE"))].pKd
    u,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(a,b,alternative="greater"); rb=2*u/(len(a)*len(b))-1
    rows.append(dict(domain=g,n_acidic_Pm3=len(a),n_other_Pm3=len(b),
                     median_pKd_acidic=round(a.median(),2),median_pKd_other=round(b.median(),2),
                     mean_pKd_acidic=round(a.mean(),2),mean_pKd_other=round(b.mean(),2),
                     rank_biserial=round(rb,3),mannwhitney_p=f"{p:.3g}"))
T2=pd.DataFrame(rows); T2.to_csv("profaff_Pminus3_affinity_test.csv",index=False); print(T2.to_string(index=False))

print("\n"+"="*84); print("TEST 3  Paralogue comparison on the shared peptide set"); print("="*84)
w=S.pivot_table(index="pep",columns="PDZ",values="pKd",aggfunc="max").dropna()
r,pr=stats.pearsonr(w.ARHGAP21,w.ARHGAP23); rs,ps=stats.spearmanr(w.ARHGAP21,w.ARHGAP23)
print(f"  {len(w)} peptides measured against both domains")
print(f"  ARHGAP21 detectable binding {100*(w.ARHGAP21>0).mean():.0f}% (median pKd of binders {w[w.ARHGAP21>0].ARHGAP21.median():.2f})")
print(f"  ARHGAP23 detectable binding {100*(w.ARHGAP23>0).mean():.0f}% (median pKd of binders {w[w.ARHGAP23>0].ARHGAP23.median():.2f})")
print(f"  Pearson r = {r:.3f} (p={pr:.3g}); Spearman rho = {rs:.3f} (p={ps:.3g})")
print(f"  Wilcoxon signed-rank ARHGAP21 > ARHGAP23: p = {stats.wilcoxon(w.ARHGAP21,w.ARHGAP23,alternative='greater').pvalue:.3g}")
w.to_csv("profaff_paralogue_matched_pKd.csv")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15.5,4.6))
d=S[S.PDZ=="ARHGAP23"]
order=["I","II","III","atypical","non-canonical P0"]
dat=[d[d.ligand_class==c].pKd.values for c in order]
bp=ax[0].boxplot(dat,labels=["I","II","III","atyp","non-\ncanon"],patch_artist=True,showfliers=False)
for b,c in zip(bp["boxes"],["#4C72B0","#B0B0B0","#B0B0B0","#B0B0B0","#B0B0B0"]): b.set_facecolor(c)
for i,v in enumerate(dat): ax[0].scatter(np.random.default_rng(i).normal(i+1,0.07,len(v)),v,s=7,color="k",alpha=.35,zorder=3)
ax[0].set_ylabel("pKd (0 = no binding detected)"); ax[0].set_xlabel("ligand class of the measured peptide")
ax[0].set_title(f"ARHGAP23 PDZ, all {len(d)} measured peptides:\nclass I peptides bind, others do not",fontsize=10)
di=d[d.ligand_class=="I"]
g1=di[di.Pm3.isin(set("DE"))].pKd; g2=di[~di.Pm3.isin(set("DE"))].pKd
bp=ax[1].boxplot([g1.values,g2.values],labels=[f"acidic P-3\n(n={len(g1)})",f"other P-3\n(n={len(g2)})"],patch_artist=True,showfliers=False)
for b,c in zip(bp["boxes"],["#4C72B0","#B0B0B0"]): b.set_facecolor(c)
for i,v in enumerate([g1.values,g2.values]): ax[1].scatter(np.random.default_rng(i).normal(i+1,0.07,len(v)),v,s=8,color="k",alpha=.4,zorder=3)
ax[1].set_ylabel("pKd"); ax[1].set_title("Within class I peptides, an acidic P-3\nraises ARHGAP23 affinity",fontsize=10)
ax[2].scatter(w.ARHGAP21,w.ARHGAP23,s=12,alpha=.5,color="#C44E52")
lim=[-0.2,max(w.max())+0.3]; ax[2].plot(lim,lim,"k--",lw=1)
ax[2].set_xlim(lim); ax[2].set_ylim(lim); ax[2].set_xlabel("ARHGAP21 PDZ pKd"); ax[2].set_ylabel("ARHGAP23 PDZ pKd")
ax[2].set_title(f"Paralogues on {len(w)} shared peptides:\ncorrelated (rho={rs:.2f}) but ARHGAP23 binds far less",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
